adj.t: gas processing plant control room operator

n.story:
Your role is evolving from a manual monitor to a sophisticated systems overseer. While the physical infrastructure of pumps and pipelines remains, the way you interact with them is changing. AI-driven SCADA systems and IoT sensors will soon handle the minute-by-minute synchronization of flow rates and pressure adjustments, tasks that once required constant manual vigilance. This automation doesn't replace you; it elevates you to a diagnostic lead who intervenes only when the most complex anomalies occur.

With AI handling the routine 'pulse' of the pumphouse, your focus shifts toward predictive maintenance and high-level troubleshooting. You will use augmented reality and AI-powered chemical analysis tools to predict equipment failure before it happens and to optimize the chemistry of oil transfers. In emergencies, you will act as a mission commander, using AI-synthesized data to make rapid, high-stakes decisions that protect both the environment and the facility's integrity.
auto: Continuous monitoring of oil circulation and flow rates

Drone-based pipeline inspection and computer vision analysis
